fields.description: Chatwoot base URL, no trailing slash. e.g. https://support.hypedrive.app
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: User Access Token for a dedicated service agent (NOT the bot token or platform token — both are rejected by conversation read endpoints). Sent as the api_access_token header.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Optional. Restrict conversation queries to this inbox (e.g. the WhatsApp inbox). Leave blank to search across all inboxes on the account.
fields.label: Default Inbox ID

fields.description: Self-imposed cache TTL for live Chatwoot reads (Chatwoot exposes no rate-limit headers — see README). Applies to conversation list/detail and message list reads.
fields.label: Cache TTL (seconds)

fields.description: Cached from the service agent's /api/v1/profile response (pubsub_token field). Used for the ActionCable RoomChannel subscription if/when a persistent WS bridge is enabled. Refreshed automatically by the poll bridge on auth failure.
fields.label: Pubsub Token (cached)
